title: Honky's Inside Voice
reason: Replace repeated shouting jokes with a clear, age-appropriate lesson about matching voice volume to distance and purpose, including a simple strategy for trying again.

pages.1: It was morning in Sunny Hollow. "Good morning!" called Honky. His big voice shook leaves from a tree.
pages.2: "That voice is too big for breakfast," said Grumpy. Honky tried again. "Good morning," he said more softly.
pages.3: "A voice can be big or small," said Bossy. "Use a small voice when friends are close."
pages.4: Honky took a slow breath. "Hello, Chompy," he said softly. Chompy's bib stayed still.
pages.5: "I did it!" Honky said. His voice grew big again. "I can try once more," he said.
pages.6: Dark clouds gathered. Thunder boomed. Dozy woke with a jump. Rain began to fall.
pages.7: "This way to the safe cave!" Honky called. His big voice helped every Dino Pal hear him.
pages.8: In the cave, Bossy smiled. "A small voice for talking. A big voice when we need it." Honky nodded. "I understand."
